description: Represents a single action taken by a participant during a combat encounter. This is a transient record, intended to be processed by a game logic service.

combatRef.description: A strong reference to the master combat instance record that this action belongs to.

actionType.description: The type of action being performed.

targetRef.description: A strong reference to the target of the action (a character profile or NPC record).

itemRef.description: If using an item, a strong reference to the item.instance record in the actor's repository.

abilityKey.description: The unique key for the ability being used (e.g., 'fireball').
